rationale: The agent located the user and order and selected an appropriate replacement (medium, blue, high ventilation) and correctly calculated the price difference ($22.55) to be charged to the original payment method. However, the agent executed the exchange (write action) without first confirming the order-changing details with the user, which violates the stated policy requiring confirmation before taking any order-changing action. While authentication steps appear to have been taken (finding the user by name and ZIP, retrieving user and order details), the lack of explicit user confirmation prior to submitting the exchange is a clear policy breach. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar despite otherwise correct processing and information provided.
